# Growth Evidence

The collaboration product has stable weekly acquisition. Sixty percent of new workspaces create a project, but only 22% invite a teammate within 7 days. Workspaces that invite a teammate show 58% W8 account retention versus 19% for those that do not. This is correlation; larger teams may both invite and retain.

The plan should identify the binding constraint, avoid generic notification tactics, and propose a minimum causal test with a product-quality guardrail.
